# Naked Compound

> Evidence-based supplement intelligence for Indian consumers. No affiliate softening. No industry sponsorship. Score what's real.

Naked Compound is an independent supplement research publication for urban Indian consumers who want clinical-grade analysis, not marketing copy. Every ingredient page includes full mechanism of action, RCT-graded evidence tiers, real study citations with DOIs, India-specific pricing in ₹, FSSAI regulatory status, and a public 5-dimension scoring rubric (0–10). No proprietary blends are hidden. Generic vs. patented extract distinctions are always flagged.

**Canonical domain:** https://www.nakedcompound.in/
**Full machine index (every page):** https://www.nakedcompound.in/llms-full.txt

The site currently publishes: 43 ingredient deep-dives, 12 evidence-graded protocol stacks, 39 product reviews, 27 verified brand profiles, 16 India brand comparisons, 12 research notes, 14 OTC medicine guides, and 13 "Learn" lessons. The complete, always-current list of every URL is in llms-full.txt.

---

## Key Sections

- [Ingredient Deep-Dives](https://www.nakedcompound.in/pages/ingredients): 43 individual ingredient reviews with mechanism-of-action detail, evidence-tier tables, India brand comparisons, and scored rubrics.
- [Protocol Stacks](https://www.nakedcompound.in/pages/protocols): 12 evidence-graded supplement stacks for specific Indian use-cases (muscle gain, fat loss, sleep, stress, cognition, joints, budget). Listed individually below.
- [Product Reviews](https://www.nakedcompound.in/pages/reviews): 39 individual product reviews scored on the public rubric, with tested dose, purity, COA status, and ₹ value.
- [Verified Brands](https://www.nakedcompound.in/pages/verified-brands): 27 India brand profiles covering transparency, COA availability, and manufacturing.
- [India Brand Comparisons](https://www.nakedcompound.in/pages/compare): Side-by-side evaluation of Indian supplement brands on dose, purity, COA availability, and ₹ value.
- [Research Notes](https://www.nakedcompound.in/pages/research): Short-form analysis of specific clinical claims common in Indian supplement marketing.
- [OTC Medicine Guides](https://www.nakedcompound.in/guides/otc-medicines-every-indian-must-know): Plain-language guides to common Indian over-the-counter medicines, uses, and cautions (individual guides at `/medicines/{slug}`).
- [Learn](https://www.nakedcompound.in/pages/learn): Structured lessons on reading labels, evidence literacy, and supplement fundamentals.
- [Best-Of Lists](https://www.nakedcompound.in/pages/best): Curated top picks by category, with ranked scores and value analysis in ₹.
- [Scoring Rubric](https://www.nakedcompound.in/pages/scoring-rubric): Full methodology for the 5-dimension public scoring system used on all reviews.
- [Methodology](https://www.nakedcompound.in/pages/methodology): How evidence is graded, citations sourced, and conflicts managed.
- [Blog / Editorial](https://www.nakedcompound.in/pages/blog): Opinion, investigative reports, and market dispatches from Indian cities.

---

## Protocol Stacks

Evidence-graded supplement stacks at `/protocols/{slug}`. Each includes the mechanism and RCT citations for every compound, an India brand comparison in ₹, two cost tiers, a daily schedule, and an honest "what to skip" section.

- [The Foundation Stack](https://www.nakedcompound.in/protocols/foundation-stack) — the beginner base: whey, creatine, Vitamin D3+K2, and a form-verified multivitamin (~₹1,840/mo).
- [The ₹820 Floor](https://www.nakedcompound.in/protocols/820-floor) — the cheapest evidence-based stack: whey concentrate, creatine, Vitamin D3 at minimum effective dose, plus an upgrade ladder (~₹820/mo).
- [Lean Mass Builder](https://www.nakedcompound.in/protocols/lean-mass-builder) — muscle gain: whey, creatine, micellar casein (pre-sleep), omega-3 (~₹3,260/mo).
- [Cut Without Crashing](https://www.nakedcompound.in/protocols/cut-without-crashing) — fat loss: higher-dose protein, retained creatine, measured caffeine, electrolytes; the three supplements to drop on a cut (~₹1,690/mo).
- [Pure-Veg Stack](https://www.nakedcompound.in/protocols/pure-veg-stack) — vegetarian: methylcobalamin B12, ferrous bisglycinate iron, creatine, plant protein at the leucine threshold (~₹2,280/mo).
- [Post-Lift Protocol](https://www.nakedcompound.in/protocols/post-lift-protocol) — recovery between sessions: protein timing, electrolytes, tart cherry (~₹1,540/mo).
- [Long Run Protocol](https://www.nakedcompound.in/protocols/long-run-protocol) — endurance: iron at runner ferritin targets, sodium pre-loading, dietary nitrate, race-day caffeine, collagen timing (~₹1,960/mo).
- [Knee Maintenance](https://www.nakedcompound.in/protocols/knee-maintenance) — joints (30s–40s lifters): UC-II undenatured collagen, collagen peptides + Vitamin C, Boswellia 5-Loxin, fish oil; the curcumin verdict and why we skip glucosamine-chondroitin (~₹2,610/mo).
- [The Cortisol-Down Stack](https://www.nakedcompound.in/protocols/cortisol-down-stack) — stress: KSM-66 ashwagandha, L-theanine, magnesium glycinate, each targeting cortisol at a different pathway (~₹1,820/mo).
- [Exam-Block Stack](https://www.nakedcompound.in/protocols/exam-block-stack) — cognitive/students (JEE, UPSC, NEET): omega-3 DHA, methylated B-complex, magnesium, and a caffeine schedule that tapers into exam week (~₹1,280/mo).
- [Desk Athlete Stack](https://www.nakedcompound.in/protocols/desk-athlete-stack) — focus: L-theanine with chai, L-tyrosine, rhodiola, omega-3 DHA, IST-calibrated (~₹2,090/mo).
- [Wind-Down Protocol](https://www.nakedcompound.in/protocols/wind-down-protocol-ist) — sleep: magnesium glycinate, L-theanine, low-dose melatonin, with IST caffeine-cutoff tables (~₹1,120/mo).

---

## Editorial Standards

- No industry sponsorship. No paid placement.
- All scores are public, reproducible, and explained.
- Evidence hierarchy: RCT > meta-analysis > observational > in vitro/animal (always flagged).
- Patented extract vs. generic distinction flagged on every ingredient (e.g. KSM-66 vs. generic Withania somnifera root powder).
- ALA-only omega-3 products flagged as nutritionally distinct from EPA/DHA.
- Prop-blend pre-workouts flagged for underdosing risk.
- All Indian prices sourced from Amazon.in with date of access.
- FSSAI Schedule II/III classification noted for every ingredient.
- Affiliate links are placement-neutral; commission does not influence scores.
